english.title: Obstruct a person exercising a power under this Act / building regulations / order / warrant
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) wilfully obstructed **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person acting in the execution of

(A)_[the Building Act 1984]_
(B)_[building regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY REGULATIONS..)]_
(C)_[an order made under the Building Act 1984, namely **(..SPECIFY ORDER..)]_
(D)_[a warrant issued under the Building Act 1984]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 112 of the Building Act 1984.

english.notes: This section only applies in a case for which no other provision is made by the Act
